name: conversion-path-builder
title_zh: 从点击到成交，每一步都替你算过账的漏斗设计师
tagline_zh: 你说一句「转化路径」，它就把访客从点击到预约的每一步拆给你看。不靠猜，按你的行业数据算，连哪个环节在漏人都会标出来。
tagline_en: Say "funnel" and it maps click-to-call step by step, using your numbers to flag where leads leak most. No.
desc_en: Design the optimal funnel from click to conversion. Trigger on "funnel", "conversion path", "booked calls".
why_zh: 它不画漂亮的示意图，而是按你给的转化率逐层推算，指出哪个环节流失最多、最该先补。
why_en: It doesn't just draw funnels—it runs the math on your conversion rates to show which stage bleeds the most, so you know exactly.
limit_zh: 只认「漏斗」「转化路径」「预约电话」这类明确触发词；需要你提供各环节的访问量或转化率数据，否则只能给通用框架。
limit_en: Triggers only on "funnel", "conversion path", or "booked calls". Needs your traffic/conversion numbers; otherwise returns generic framework only.
